decision_rationale: The record presents a new multi-task foundation model, not a review, benchmark, or wrapper. It is built on biological modalities and uses structured prompts/sequence-to-sequence generation across those modalities.
evidence_snippet: "a multi-task foundation model that learns from large-scale biological datasets across diverse modalities, including proteins, small-molecules, and omics"; "MAMMAL's structured prompt syntax supports classification, regression, and generation tasks"; "supports both encoder-only and encoder-decoder autoregressive modes"
